headline: Redevelopment projects of 500 households or fewer to be entrusted to district heads
summary: South Korea decided to transfer authority for redevelopment projects of 500 households or fewer to district heads. The plan also shortens the permit approval period for redevelopment and reconstruction projects, aiming to expand housing supply.
why: Housing supply rules and permit timelines influence construction activity, property development and residential prices in South Korea.
